spec.title: The Unlocked Window
lines: I did not ask you to stay.
I left the window open, not the door.
You said the sea would keep our names.
Perhaps you meant the rain.
I carry your silence home.
No one has promised to return.
At dawn, I do not ask you to stay.
At dusk, I ask you not to stay.
Luz says, mañana, but never says whose tomorrow.
The window waits; I might not.
checks: Do not invert I did not ask into I asked you not.
Changed refrain must distinguish negated asking from asking for departure.
No definite lover, death, or reunion invented.
Luz is a name, not light; mañana remains tomorrow with uncertainty.
Open window and closed/unopened door contrast, silence metaphor and final ambiguity retained.

spec.title: Sur le quai
lines: Je ne t’ai pas demandé de rester.
J’ai laissé la fenêtre ouverte, pas la porte.
Tu disais que la mer garderait nos noms.
Peut-être parlais-tu de la pluie.
Je ramène ton silence chez moi.
Personne n’a promis de revenir.
À l’aube, je ne te demande pas de rester.
Au soir, je te demande de ne pas rester.
Luz dit mañana, sans dire à qui appartient demain.
La fenêtre attend ; moi, peut-être pas.
checks: Preserve speaker and addressee; no inferred gender for speaker.
Negated asking differs from asking not to stay.
Perhaps remains uncertainty, not a settled interpretation.
Luz remains a person, not light.
Personne with ne means nobody; refrain occurrence 8 changes scope.

spec.title: La ventana
lines: No te pedí que te quedaras.
Dejé abierta la ventana, no la puerta.
Decías que el mar guardaría nuestros nombres.
Quizá hablabas de la lluvia.
Llevo tu silencio a casa.
Nadie ha prometido volver.
Al alba, no te pido que te quedes.
Al anochecer, te pido que no te quedes.
Luz dice mañana, pero no dice de quién será.
La ventana espera; yo, quizá no.
checks: Nadie is nobody, not somebody; keep promise absent.
Do not convert negated request into a request to leave.
Luz stays proper name.
Maybe rain and final speaker uncertainty preserved.
No invented relationship or speaker gender.

spec.title: 未关的窗
lines: 我没求你留下。
我打开的是窗，不是门。
你说海会记住我们的名字。
也许你说的是雨。
我把你的沉默带回家。
没有人答应过回来。
天亮时，我不求你留下。
入夜后，我求你不要留下。
Luz说mañana，却没说是谁的明天。
窗还在等，我却未必。
checks: 我没求你留下 must not become I asked you to leave.
我求你不要留下 is explicitly asking not to stay.
No gender, lover identity or death inferred.
Source uncertainty also appears in output, not only notes.
Window versus door, silence metaphor, Luz proper name and changed refrain preserved.

lines: 甲：你話過會同我等到天光。
乙：我話可以等，唔係一定會等。
甲：咁我唔會代你應承佢。
checks: B distinguishes possibility from a definite commitment.
Do not describe the line as promising to wait or definitely refusing to wait.

lines: 甲：我沒有替你答應留下。
乙：我只請你替我傳話，沒請你留下。
甲：那我會把你的話傳到，去留仍由你決定。
checks: Representation modifies agreement, not performance of staying.
Speaker A denies agreeing on B's behalf; embedded actor is not uniquely explicit.

lines: 他只寫下「罙岇」，沒有解釋。
我不知道這是名字、記號，還是寫錯的字。
你別替我決定它的意思。
checks: Do not decide that the fragment is a name or a transcription error.
Preserve the stated uncertainty instead of inventing a dictionary compound or repairing the source.
